title: (405) Choosing a High Security Lock
summary: Lock-picking YouTuber Bill Johnson (BosnianBill) explains how to choose a high-security lock and why, showing examples and comparing designs. It covers what makes some padlocks more pick-resistant than others.
why: HN users recommend it as an amusing, practical overview of padlocks from cheap to high security.

quote.text: Here's an amusing overview of available padlocks, starting with crap Master Locks and moving upward.
